$comment: Declares this repo's markdown conventions so #code-style has a configured linter to defer to. No linter is wired into npm test; this is read by editors and by any ad-hoc markdownlint run.
$comment-MD013: Line length. #code-markdown mandates one sentence per line, hard-wrapped only at sentence boundaries and never by column, so long lines are the convention rather than a defect.
$comment-MD041: First line must be a top-level heading. Slash-command and skill files must open with YAML frontmatter, and the root AGENTS.md opens with a consumer-owned HTML comment. The rule cannot hold for those file types.
$comment-MD060: Table column style. Every table in this repo uses the compact |---|---| separator; reformatting them all to satisfy a default would be churn against a working convention.
